ui.chat.commentary_actions.label.role: accessible name of the hover-only toolbar over an in-between status message (mid-turn narration that carries its own tool calls; Copy alone)
ui.chat.commentary_actions.label.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.commentary_actions.label.note: Screen-reader only. Must differ from both the closing answer's "Answer actions" and a non-closing final response's "Response actions", so one turn never announces two identically named toolbars. English is the bundled fallback for locales that have not audited this key.
